finding.text: Requirement 1 (reconnect, failures in a log the owner can open) is not shown in this diff or shots: the diff holds only a `Sheet.js` min-height clamp, a surfaces `md()` paragraph and the after PNGs; `shots/reconnect-up.png` and `reconnect-down.png` are not evidence of a log line or a button retry. Show the Connection change and the log link, or say it landed in an earlier commit.

Requirement 3 "the page behind stays visible" is only partly met: at 60% (`shots/after/sheet-001.png`) the page shows just the title and tabs; by `sheet-009.png` (90% snap) the page is fully covered, which the owner accepts as snap-open. But the Done-when 400 and 1200 `check_page` run is not shown.

`layout.json` wraps at 400: the bottom rail buttons `drawer-rail-ai` and `drawer-rail-menu` report 3.2 lines (icon stacked over label, likely by design), and the page title wraps to 2 lines ("Voice and chat surfaces").

`shots/after/sheet-001.png`: the compact sheet head ("AI ▾ New session /framework/ux/Dictate/ × ") has no grey down-arrow button, which meets the "remove or make obvious" ask; the "New session" chip is a solid orange block that reads heavier than the rest of the header.
The footer mic row in `sheet-021.png` has a grey fill that differs from the white head, so the two sticky rows do not match.
